title: AC Power Cord- C14 to C19,18 AWG-6Ft For Cisco PWR-2700-AC

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
AC Power Cord | C14 to C19 | 18 AWG | 6 ft | Black

This premium 6Ft AC Power Cord features C14 to C19 connectors with a durable 18 AWG gauge, delivering safe and efficient power for demanding equipment. Designed for Cisco PWR-2700-AC, it is also compatible with a wide range of C14 inlet devices including Cisco UCS series servers, Catalyst switches, Nexus switches; HP ProLiant DL/ML servers; Dell PowerEdge R/T series; APC Smart-UPS models; IBM System x servers; and PDUs from APC, Tripp Lite, and Eaton. Perfect for data centers, enterprise networks, and professional IT environments, this cable ensures reliable performance and long service life.

Supply End:

C14, or IEC60320-C14, is a 3 prong, male connector commonly used as a PDU supply end and computer power supply. These ends plug into a C14, or IEC60320-C13.

Equipment End:

C19, or IEC60320-C19 is a 3 prong, female connector commonly used on the end of high current computer and networking device power cords.These ends plug into a C20, or IEC60320-C20.

Features:

Equipment end IEC60320-C19 is a 3 prong, female connector

Supply end IEC60320-C14, is a 3 prong, male connector

The power cord has a thickness of 18AWG 

The cord is 6ft in length
